edge_explainer: MODE B LED. The court question was UK-hospitality derailment vs de-rate. Ruling: DERAILMENT that has plateaued, not a de-rate -- operating profit fell 45% on a 7% revenue decline over FY23-25 (margin 12.4% -> 10.2% -> 7.4%, EPS 70.2p -> 39.7p) as fixed-cost kiln deleverage ran through a contracting hospitality market; the multiple followed estimates down rather than compressing against them. H1-2026 sales GBP 37.4m vs 38.5m is still declining but decelerating, and the 31-Jul-2026 update reports stabilised trading, improving factory yields and hedged energy -- a real self-help margin option, not a fact. DECISIVE MODE-B FINDING: the pension surplus trap is CONFIRMED and it is a CASH finding, not a book finding. AR2025 Note 19 carries a GBP 7,651k surplus in book equity (IFRIC-14 recoverable-on-cessation, unrestricted) while the Aug-2024 triennial schedule contractually restarts GBP 1.75m/yr from Sept-2026 to Jun-2029 (~GBP 4.96m). Per the LSE addendum the surplus is stripped from book: equity 61,539 -> 53,888, BVPS 559.6p -> 490.0p, P/B 0.688 -> 0.786. Far more important, charged against FCF: FY25 FCF GBP 4,992k less pension 1,750k less the already-cut dividend (21.0p x 10.998m = 2,310k) leaves GBP 932k -- 81% of free cash flow is committed the moment the schedule restarts in seven weeks, taking FCF yield from 11.8% to 7.7%. The note itself ties pension payments to dividend policy, so the 5.45% yield is the thing most at risk, not the support. SECOND MODE-B FINDING: the 31-Jul update's 'cash generation remained strong' (GBP 8.8m vs 5.6m, +3.2m) is 43% explained by paying a smaller dividend -- FY24 final 26.5p (GBP 2.914m, paid May-2025) vs FY25 final 14.0p (GBP 1.540m, paid May-2026) = GBP 1.374m of the GBP 3.2m improvement. The operating improvement is ~GBP 1.8m, not GBP 3.2m. Both findings are DISCLOSED IN FULL -- these are review flags on emphasis, zero divergence of fact. ANTI-MASKING CREDIT IS LARGE AND VERIFIED ON FOUR AXES: headcount 836 -> 687 (-17.8%) taken through the P&L with ZERO exceptional charges (the industry-standard move is a restructuring provision that flatters adjusted profit -- they declined it, so the 7.4% margin is a clean 7.4%); dividend cut 44.7% on both legs rather than defending an uncoverable payout; zero buyback in FY24/FY25 despite standing authority and boilerplate (no manufactured support); net cash, no bank debt, no covenants, capital commitments a trivial GBP 244k. PwC's switch of materiality benchmark to 1% of REVENUE because 'profit as a percentage of total revenue has declined... considered to be low' is a soft profitability warning left visible inside the audit report; the PwC -> Forvis Mazars change is a pre-announced competitive tender and must NOT be scored as a resignation. Per house doctrine this is CLEAN: re-detecting honestly disclosed bad news is not alpha, and a genuinely impaired business that discloses its impairment is not the catch. WHY IT STOPS AT 3: derailment fails the frame's central de-rate test; +42.1% off a 134-day intraday low (+35.1% off a 119-day close low) means the easy re-rating is behind us; E[FV] 409p gives only +6.1% gross, which does not survive a 260bp round-trip touch on a line needing 3-8 sessions to exit; and the print that decides the base case is 4-5 weeks away. Valuation finding -> price gate (the only case where a price gate is the right instrument), plus a business-risk finding -> one-notch size cut. Cap structure pulled before any EV claim: 10,997,835 ordinary shares only, no warrants/preferred/converts, so EV GBP 34.92m (cap 42.34m less net cash 7.42m = cash 10,808 - leases 3,384) and EV/EBIT 6.19x are safe to assert; charging the pension schedule as an EV-like claim (PV ~GBP 4.5m) takes it to 7.0x. Not AI-complex: the entry neither requires the AI cycle to hold nor benefits if it breaks -- the frozen AI-BREAK|2027-12-31 @0.45 call is orthogonal here, stated so it is not averaged away by silence. TOP UNVERIFIABLE: pension administration costs quadrupled to GBP 382k (from GBP 94k) with no explanation in the note -- 5% of operating profit appearing silently; benign readings exist (triennial/IFRIC-14 fees, GMP work) but preparatory buy-in/buy-out advisory is not excluded. Also unverified: H2-2026 order visibility (company says outright that visibility is limited and Q4 is significant) and the sell-side estimate trajectory (Investec/Panmure forecasts are outside the free corpus, so the estimate test runs on company-reported actuals).
